hook: In 1880, Sherlock Holmes investigations didn't align with Cthulhu Mythos stories from 1925.

sections.voiceover: In 1880, Sherlock Holmes investigations didn't align with Cthulhu Mythos stories from 1925.
sections.visual_cue: Split-screen showing 1890 London and a 1925 calendar page.

sections.voiceover: In 1890, Arthur Conan Doyle's detective faces strange spherical bones in London's East End. How do these two distinct realities converge?
sections.visual_cue: Map of London's East End highlighting 1890, then a graphic showing a timeline from 1880 to 1914.

sections.voiceover: Except the Cthulhu Mythos tales are primarily set between 1925 and 1935.
sections.visual_cue: Graphic showing the 1925-1935 period overlapping with the earlier timeline.

sections.voiceover: James Lovegrove attempts to bridge this gap in his novels. His work follows Neil Gaiman, who won a 2004 Hugo Award for similar pastiches.
sections.visual_cue: Portrait of James Lovegrove, then a book cover graphic for the Hugo Award-winning story.

sections.voiceover: The 1890 setting remains the anchor for this collision.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of the 1890 date on an old ledger.
